text_block_list.text: One day, as summer was drawing near—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Hrm, I wonder if there's anything 
special about McQueen's running...

Lately, Tokai Teio has been watching race 
footage of Mejiro McQueen before training.

The reason was to search for what she had 
that was missing in myself, but—
choice_data_list: Feel like you're getting the hang of it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I know she's strong, for sure, but 
I wouldn't say she's completely unbeatable 
no matter how many times you run.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Oh well, time to watch the next race. 
There are tons of videos, so I gotta keep 
a brisk pace."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
N-No... it's just, that was from when I 
lost to McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't need to watch this anymore. I 
saw it with my own eyes, after all."

And so, after watching several race 
recordings, Tokai Teio's training began.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whew... *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? That time just now 
wasn't bad, right?

In fact, even after losing to Mejiro 
McQueen, Tokai Teio's running was not bad 
at all.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~ Right~?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And yet, why would the Prez say McQueen is 
gonna win instead of me?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oops, no use just standing here talking. 
Time to train, train, train!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer, time me one more time. I 
think I'll get a way better time next!"

Without ever letting her spirits break, 
Tokai Teio continues running forward with 
optimism today.

These were her strengths, her greatest 
virtues, and yet, what was it that she was 
still lacking—?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Whoa... McQueen-san, that's amaaazing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: McQueen-san, that was a great run!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was right after all. Her old 
strength really has returned!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...That is not correct. Back then and 
right now are entirely different things.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well then, I shall go for one more lap.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"A different beast... that might actually 
be true. It's like her whole aura changed 
after that string of losses."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Her drive is completely different now, 
isn't it...

Just as the Umamusume said, despite being 
backed as the 1st favorite last year, she 
suffered a string of defeats.

Those consecutive defeats seem to have 
been the turning point that led to who she 
is today, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In any case, the me standing here today is 
different from who I was before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I shall surely ascend. From the 'earth' 
to the 'heavens'...

At the press conference, I could feel her 
fierce determination to crawl her way back 
up from rock bottom...

Could it be that what the current Tokai 
Teio is lacking is—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Phew...! Goal! Hey, hey, how was my time?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, you didn't even time it?! What 
are you doing, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: Was it frustrating to lose, Teio?
Were you frustrated by that loss, Teio?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh...? What's up, so suddenly?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, about my race with McQueen? Well of 
course, I was like, "Daaarn it!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I can't keep looking down forever, 
right? After all, I'm the Umamusume who's 
gonna surpass the Prez!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...More importantly! Make sure to time me 
properly~!"

It seems her unyielding spirit in the face 
of frustration is both her greatest 
strength and her greatest flaw—
The next day—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Now then, time to watch McQueen's race! 
Trainer, get everything ready, pleeease!

When she came to watch race footage again 
today, I decided to show her a certain 
video.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: H-Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't this from when I lost to 
McQueen?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you~, I saw it with my own two 
eyes, so it's totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wh-What...? Why are you asking that?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I was running right there with you, so I 
saw it...
choice_data_list: Were you too frustrated to watch?
Were you too frustrated to watch?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm not frustrated at all! A loss like 
that, I can make up for with a rematch 
right away!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I can't just sit here feeling 
bitter!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"If I admit I'm frustrated, it's like 
admitting that I'm weak, right?!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna become an Umamusume who 
surpasses the Prez, so I've gotta be 
strong!

The fact that she talked back is proof 
that she still feels frustration inside.

She was desperately trying not to show it, 
determined to maintain her aura of 
strength, but—
choice_data_list:
Frustration makes people work so much 
harder...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Frustration... makes you put in effort?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
B-But after all, there's no way I'm not 
frustrated...!
choice_data_list:
Accept your frustration and become 
stronger!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But...
choice_data_list:
I'll make sure to back you up with 
everything I've got!

I'll be right there to support you all the 
way!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
And when the time for training arrived—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
How was that, Trainer? I tried paying 
extra attention to my footwork.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Alright! One more run at this pace!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... There's a different kind of drive 
today.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, Prez!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry, I'm really happy you came all the 
way here, but I have to go train!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Because I don't wanna lose anymore! I 
never want to feel that frustration ever 
again!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, I'm heading out! Trainer, 
keep track of my time for me!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I see. Looks like Teio grasped 
something important too.
choice_data_list:
Teio's only going to get even stronger 
from here!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, use that frustration as a springboard 
to get stronger... Teio!

Having known true frustration and turning 
those feelings into strength, Tokai Teio 
began to run once again.
